commit_message: Fix ADR0127 remaining affected validation failures
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Fixes the exact fd14a10 affected Windows Validation failures without suppressing lints: groups Tile Map pointer context to reduce argument count, collapses equivalent pointer conditionals, expresses manifest filtering as filter+map, and updates the registration-order contract test to the actual append-preserving Native 2D declaration order.
